projects.description: Automated uptime, latency, and SLA monitoring daemon with webhook alerting and SQLite incident metrics.
High-performance CLI utility for auditing YAML/JSON configuration files, identifying CVE misconfigurations, and generating compliance scorecards.
End-to-end incident management and task orchestration portal featuring FastAPI REST backend, SQLite persistence, and responsive interactive web UI.
High-performance CLI utility for auditing YAML/JSON configuration files, identifying CVE misconfigurations, and generating compliance scorecards.
Production-ready semantic RAG context engine with dynamic chunk re-ranking, token budget optimizer, and citation verification.

An automated database schema drift detection and live migration workbench that inspects SQLite and SQLAlchemy models, calculates structural differences, and provides a real-time web portal to generate and test deterministic rollback migrations.

An intelligent log anomaly detection and root-cause analysis engine that ingests unstructured application logs, parses them into structured Pydantic models using regex-pattern learning, and exposes a high-performance FastAPI/Rich CLI suite to instantly isolate stack traces, recurring system errors, and performance bottlenecks.

A production-ready LLM proxy gateway and safety orchestrator that enforces security guardrails, semantic prompt caching, and structured output validation. It intercepts LLM API calls to sanitize PII, block prompt injections, serve instant cached responses for semantically equivalent queries, and guarantee schema compliance.

A high-performance webhook orchestration platform and developer portal that ingests, verifies, transforms, and reliably dispatches third-party event streams. It pairs an asynchronous FastAPI backend with a real-time React/TypeScript control plane to provide deep traffic inspection, custom payload reshaping, and resilient delivery retry mechanisms.
